[ipa-delivery:830] Build the private RewindBox IPA 830: S2Arm patches 0332 to 0340 for Mario Kart World, MeloNX Core 7cf4ff80d for Hogwarts, DeSmuME 3D supersampling

Frozen on the draft 38c0a251, base the verified 829. S2Arm engine pin
f0e555af (run 45329221310, artifact 14892675111): the Fair thermal
scale, the thermal guest QoS, the memory tier held by compressed
memory, the per-piece wait for the encode thread, the thermal DRS steps
and the dark-frame probe off by default; the acquire sync at the
present that took the texture off screen, as on the device; the
translation core at -O2. MeloNX Core 7cf4ff80d (pin 97dfda63); libretro
collection LibretroCores-67ce2d3b with the bridge and App changes.
Nothing is measured on an iPhone yet.
